contract.formula: Two tangent lengths sqrt(|endpoint-corner|^2-r^2), original side lengths |v5-v4|+|v4-v3|, plus r times the total clockwise normal-angle sweep between entry/exit tangencies.
contract.finite_model: Circumscribe each circular arc using intersections of consecutive support lines. Extra length per arc interval delta is2r*tan(delta/2)-r*delta. Chords through the circle are not safe.
contract.taut_proof: Future continuous shortest length > finite material length*(1+1e-6)+1e-6 proves insufficiency. A sampled path length by itself is an upper bound and cannot supply that proof.
contract.scope: Cords around the held sharp prism with Euclidean radius. Exact analytical expressions evaluated in binary64, not interval-certified arithmetic. Geometry and small controls only.

cases.scope: Continuous route is exact for the stated offset polygon and upper routing class. The circumscribed finite polyline is separately safe and slightly longer. No finite solver exact-taut claim or native pull run.
